facts.text: The daily wages for a group of 200 persons were obtained from a frequency distribution of a continuous variable X.
The frequency distribution for U had values -2, -1, 0, 1, and 2.
The number of persons corresponding to U = -2 was 7.
The number of persons corresponding to U = -1 was 50.
The number of persons corresponding to U = 0 was 80.
The number of persons corresponding to U = 1 was 60.
The number of persons corresponding to U = 2 was 3.
The task was to calculate the median, lower quartile, upper quartile, 3rd decile, and 98th percentile.
